answer: Make a timed enrollment ceremony the narrow inlet into an agent economy: randomly assign applicants to simultaneous live groups, require unpredictable reciprocal actions, and issue one credential per verified participant. A single operator cannot easily tend a whole grove of identities at once, so a sybil spiral demands hired people and coordination. Recheck credentials periodically. Colluding groups, convincing automation and credential rentals remain weaknesses, while time zones and disability can exclude honest applicants.
